questions.prompt_en: More employees are working from home instead of travelling to an office every day. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this development. Write at least 250 words.
questions.prompt_vi: Address both advantages and disadvantages, with relevant examples and a reasoned conclusion.

answer.model_en:
Working from home has become a common option for many employees. Although this arrangement can make daily life more convenient, it may also create problems for communication and work-life balance. This essay will discuss both its benefits and drawbacks.

One major advantage is that employees can save time and money by avoiding a daily journey to the office. For example, someone who previously spent two hours travelling each day could use that time to exercise, prepare meals or spend time with family. Working from home can also give people more control over their schedule. This may help workers concentrate on tasks that require quiet conditions, such as writing reports or checking data. Employers may benefit too, because they sometimes need less office space. For organisations operating in expensive city centres, reducing the number of desks could free up money for equipment or staff development.

However, remote work also has disadvantages. Employees who rarely meet their colleagues may find it harder to share ideas or solve problems quickly. New workers can be particularly affected because they often learn by observing more experienced staff. Another difficulty is that the boundary between work and personal life can become unclear. If someone answers messages late at night, they may feel that the working day never ends.

In conclusion, working from home offers clear advantages, particularly lower travel costs and greater flexibility. Nevertheless, it can reduce personal contact and make it harder to switch off after work. In my view, a balanced arrangement, with some days at home and some in the office, may help organisations gain the benefits while limiting the disadvantages.
